_provenance.purpose: Grounded alias table so an Intelligence extinction pass (energy-extinction.js pattern) does not falsely retire activations. activeTriggers = active condition-codes + active diagnosis ids (energy-telemetry-adapter.js L48-53). This table bridges the pulse-engine condition-code vocabulary to the activations' diagnosticTriggers via the real family->contract->issue-circuit chain.
_provenance.derivationChain: condition-code --(intelligence-pulse-engine.js classify loop L142-166)--> evidence families --(EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS.requiredFamilies, OR-gate L176-182)--> diagnosis id --(intelligence.json issues[]._authored||circuits)--> circuit nodeIds --(those nodeIds are activations whose diagnosticTriggers are diagnosis ids)--> diagnosticTriggers.
_provenance.foldRule: A diagnosis is folded into a condition-code only when the condition's emitted families intersect that diagnosis requiredFamilies (matching the actual OR-gate at L176-182). Because ALL FIVE contracts list news_event, every news_event-emitting condition (groups A,B,C,E) folds all 5 diagnoses; each link is annotated diagnosis-primary vs shared-catch(news_event). Group D emits no news_event, so it folds only the 4 diagnoses reachable via oversight_event/intel_event (CYBER_ESPIONAGE excluded).
_provenance.discipline: No link invented. Conditions with no defensible chain are under unmapped. Trigger strings copied verbatim from intelligence.json; extinction matching is case-insensitive (energy-extinction.js L22,L29).
_provenance.heterogeneityVsFinanceAndEnergy: (1) Finance/Energy condition-codes had DISTINCT primary families (banking_event, market_event, currency_event, fraud_event) so folds were specific; Intelligence's 5 contracts ALL share news_event, making the OR-gate extremely permissive (any news_event condition validates all 5). (2) Intelligence's EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS declare primaryIndicators (intel_gap, cyber_espionage, classified_leak...) but computePulse NEVER reads them - validation is purely family-based off the _activeConditions classify loop; those tokens are decorative (see contractDeclaredButEngineUnconsumed). (3) intel_event maps to BOTH INTELLIGENCE_FAILURE and FOREIGN_INTERFERENCE, and oversight_event to BOTH MASS_SURVEILLANCE_SCANDAL and WHISTLEBLOWER_CRISIS, so even 'distinctive' families are 2-to-1, not 1-to-1. (4) structural_event and macro_event are emitted but named in no contract requiredFamilies (dead-ends). (5) Orphan count: Energy 1, Finance 3, Intelligence 1 (WERN).

assets/js/energy-telemetry-adapter.js (REFERENCE pattern for activeTriggers build + alias expansion + node-active-from-circuit; no intelligence-telemetry-adapter.js exists yet)
assets/js/energy-extinction.js (REFERENCE match semantics L20-42; no intelligence-extinction.js exists yet)
_provenance.note: Generated deterministically from the above sources. Read-only reference data; nothing here writes intelligence.json or fires extinction. No intelligence-specific adapter/extinction module exists yet; this table follows the Energy contract so one can consume it unchanged.

conditionCodes.reason: intelligence-pulse-engine.js classifies these -> evidence family [structural_event] (L164), but NO EVIDENCE_CONTRACT lists structural_event in requiredFamilies. Dead-end family: reaches no diagnosis, hence no circuit, hence no activation. No grounded alias. (These feed the stress catch-all only for INTELLIGENCE_FAILURE via catchAllBlocked:false, i.e. a diagnosis externally marked active WITHOUT evidence, not via any condition->family->contract link.)

Classified -> evidence family [macro_event] (L165), but macro_event appears in no requiredFamilies. It is listed as a secondaryConfirmation on CYBER_ESPIONAGE and FOREIGN_INTERFERENCE, but secondaryConfirmation is NEVER read by the code gate (only requiredFamilies is checked, L176-182). Dead-end; no grounded alias. (Same shape as Finance macro_shock.)

activationsWithTriggersButNoTriggerSourc.reason: Activation has diagnosticTriggers but its brainNodeId appears in NO issue._authored||circuits circuit (and no condition-code chain reaches it). Under current wiring the adapter never marks it active (participation count 0), so extinction would ALWAYS list it for retirement. No grounded alias exists; NOT fabricated. WERN (Wernicke's / OSINT) needs authoring into an issue circuit - e.g. INTELLIGENCE_FAILURE or FOREIGN_INTERFERENCE, which are its own declared triggers - before extinction should touch it. (Intelligence analog of the Energy Data Centers/HYPO orphan; Intelligence has ONE, vs Finance's three.)

activationsUnreachableButExemptFromExtin.reason: Unreachable by any issue circuit, but diagnosticTriggers is empty, so energy-extinction.js L30 skips it entirely (never an extinction candidate). No alias needed.

contractDeclaredButEngineUnconsumed.reason: These are the EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS primaryIndicators. Unlike Finance (where indicator tokens were also the classify vocabulary), intelligence-pulse-engine.js computePulse NEVER reads primaryIndicators - the validation gate is purely family-based off the _activeConditions classify loop. So no primaryIndicator token participates in any condition->diagnosis chain; none needs an alias. NOTE: 'network_intrusion' coincidentally also appears in the classify loop (group C, cyber_event) - there it IS consumed; as a CYBER_ESPIONAGE primaryIndicator it is not.
